name: nexus-flow
description: Nexus Flow is a Flask + MongoDB application that generates complete, static websites from natural-language prompts. Its AI engine is driven by **JARVIS** — a no-key agent that orchestrates the AI conversation system and dispatches all generation/modification/chat to the configured model engines (**LM Studio (Qwen2.5-Coder)** → **Ollama** → **Gemini** → OpenAI), with Gemini as the automatic fallback. It combines an AI chat-driven builder with a visual code editor, live preview, version history, downloads, ZIP/deploy export, dashboard, and admin console.
